disposition_reason: Experimental fish toxicogenomics; liver uranium values follow controlled exposure and are not food occurrence data.

study.method: microarray, qPCR; uranium in water and liver

non_numeric_findings: Liver uranium 2.9 ± 1.5, 4.9 ± 1.9 and 7.5 ± 2.1 ng/g wet weight after 48 h at nominal 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 mg/L (n = 3) (p. 3).
847, 891 and 766 differentially expressed liver genes; mitochondrial and oxidative stress pathways affected (abstract, p. 1).
